subject: Re: Request: vulnerability management artifacts for FinTrust SOC 2 review
messages:
From: Emily Chen <security@fintrust.com>
To: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
Cc: audit@fintrust.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: vulnerability management artifacts for FinTrust SOC 2 review

Hi Priyom,

We're preparing FinTrust's SOC 2 evidence package and need Redwood's vulnerability management artifacts to complete our control mapping. Specifically can you provide the following by end of day 2027-04-22: 

- Latest authenticated network & credentialed host scan index (last 90 days)
- Patch/patch-window logs showing deployments that remediate medium/high CVEs (with PR/CL references)
- A CSV of CVEs closed in the past 180 days with closure dates and mitigations
- Your VM cadence (scan frequency), SLA commitments for CVE severity tiers, and escalation path for critical incidents
- Any SOC2-relevant playbook snippets or remediation runbooks we can reference

We will mark the packet as "in review" once we receive the consolidated bundle. If there are items you cannot share (e.g., raw host lists), indicate the equivalent evidence. Point of contact for acceptance is me (Emily Chen).

Thanks,
Emily Chen
Senior Information Security Officer
FinTrust
---
Attachments: none
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: vulnerability management artifacts for FinTrust SOC 2 review

Emily,

Thanks for the request — appreciate the clear list. We're on it and can deliver a consolidated packet ahead of your deadline. High-level plan: 

- We will produce an authenticated scan snapshot (redacted host identifiers) plus a scan-index CSV for traceability.
- Patch logs will include timestamps, PR/CL references, and deployment windows; I will coordinate PR references with engineering.
- CVE closure CSV will list CVE, model/service affected, closure date, mitigation type (patch/workaround/configuration), and responsible owner.
- VM cadence: weekly authenticated host scans, daily infra quick checks, monthly third-party dependency scans. SLA commitments below (we'll include in the packet): Critical: 48 hours to Triage + emergency patching; High: 30 days; Medium: 90 days (business-priority exceptions recorded).
- We'll attach a short remediation-playbook snippet and a SOC2-readme that maps each artifact to the SOC 2 control.

Deliverables (expected by Tue 2027-04-20 EOD): scan-snapshot-20270401.json (redacted), scan-index-20270401.csv, patch-log-20270411.pdf, cve-closure-commit.csv, remediation-playbook-2027-04.md, soc2-readme-20270420.txt

Point of contact for technical questions: Marissa Cole (CC). Ben is CC'd to ensure contract-related items are visible. If you need a stricter redaction format, let us know now so we can adjust.

Thanks,
--
Priyom Das
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Emily / team,

I'll assemble the patch logs and the CVE closure CSV. Quick status and list of items I'm pulling: 

- Patch log extraction (services: runtime, orchestration, control plane) with PR/CL links and deploy timestamps
- CVE closure export from our tracker (will include mitigation notes + evidence links)
- Redacted authenticated scan JSON + index CSV (no plaintext hostnames; we will provide stable internal IDs and a mapping index locked to the packet)
- Remediation playbook snippet: our triage -> assessment -> rollout steps and emergency mitigations

Open questions for Emily: acceptance criteria for redaction (masking scheme OK: host-<shortid>), and do you need raw SRR/scan raw output or just the indexed snapshots?

I'll target sending the first draft to Priyom & Emily by Mon 2027-04-19 lunchtime for quick review, then final bundle Tue 2027-04-20.

Emily / FinTrust Audit team,

Please find attached the consolidated vulnerability management packet for the SOC 2 review. Summary below; attachments are included in the Drive folder link.

Summary highlights:
- Scan cadence: weekly authenticated host scans (every Monday 02:00 UTC), daily infra health probes, monthly dependency scans (third-party libs).
- SLA commitments: Critical (CVSS >=9): initial triage within 48 hours; remediation plan within 7 days; emergency patching when vendor fix available; High (CVSS 7-8.9): Mitigate within 30 days; Medium: 90 days (exceptions tracked).
- Closure table: 72 CVEs closed in the last 180 days; cve-closure-commit.csv includes CVE id, affected component, closure date, PR/CL ref, mitigation type, owner.
- Patch logs: patch-log-20270411.pdf contains deploy windows, rollback notes, and PR links for the items listed in the CSV.
- Playbook: remediation-playbook-2027-04.md includes triage flow and emergency escalation contact points (on-call + security lead).

Attachments included: scan-snapshot-20270401.json (redacted), scan-index-20270401.csv, patch-log-20270411.pdf, cve-closure-commit.csv, remediation-playbook-2027-04.md, soc2-readme-20270420.txt
